description: Run a SQL query against Google BigQuery and return a pandas DataFrame. Drop-in peer of duckdb_query_reader (DuckDB) and database_query (generic SQL). For multi-asset 'import every BQ entity as an asset' use google_bigquery instead.

outputs.description: BigQuery query result as a pandas DataFrame, with bytes_processed / cache_hit / slot_millis exposed in metadata.

project_id.label: Project ID
project_id.description: Billing project for the BQ job. Defaults to the SA's project.

query.label: Query
query.description: SQL query. Supports {placeholder} substitution from query_params; partition_key is auto-added.

query_params.label: Query Params
query_params.description: Mapping substituted into {placeholder} segments before submission.

dry_run.label: Dry Run
dry_run.description: Validate the query and report byte estimate without scanning data.

max_rows.label: Max Rows
max_rows.description: Hard cap on result rows fetched.

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Deps

partition_type.description: Partition type: 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'hourly', 'static', 'multi', 'dynamic', or None for unpartitioned.
partition_type.label: Partition Type

partition_start.description: Partition start date in ISO format, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based partition types.
partition_start.label: Partition Start

partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning, e.g. 'customer_a,customer_b,customer_c'.
partition_values.label: Partition Values

partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec: list of {name, type, start, values, dynamic_partition_name} dicts. Overrides flat fields when set.
partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions

name: BigQuery Query Asset
